design.boundary: pub(crate) synchronous generic with_query_base(base: Option<&str>, f: impl FnOnce()->T)->T; private owned guard in exec, never returned, no public guard/installer.
design.state: Own the previous Option<oxiri::Iri<String>> by value; PhantomData<Rc<()>> matches existing budget guard pattern and implies !Send + !Sync without allocation/dependency.
design.install: Compute next using the exact old base.and_then(|s| Iri::parse(s.to_string()).ok()) before touching TLS; then one short RefCell::replace to take predecessor. Release borrow before invoking f.
design.drop: QUERY_BASE.try_with; inside short borrow replace/take previous owned Option, including None; ignore only AccessError from destroyed TLS. Do not hide borrow failure or carry any RefCell borrow over user code.
design.unwind: RAII restores during panic=unwind; release/release-fast/release-wasm are panic=abort so no caught-unwind claim for those binaries. Thread teardown AccessError tolerance is a design invariant; no contrived destructor-order runtime proof promised.
design.order: Wrap the exact setter-to-return region independently at each site. ANALYZE differs materially from ordinary query/cache sites; see site-plan.json.
design.removal: Delete set_query_base entirely; workspace tracked-source search currently finds exactly11 calls and only its TLS reads/writes in exec. Removing the old function makes any future stale caller fail compilation.
design.unchanged: resolve_iri, parser/rewrite, dataset/view, functions, trace, cache key/locking, all worker dispatch, budget and query-now logic remain unchanged.
